provenance: existing hand-labelled golden set (tests/eval/golden_queries.json); anchors are expected chunk texts mapped to live chunks; not independently re-validated
notes: 36 labelled chunks across 3 documents, 30 queries. No labels were fabricated for this run.

queries.query: How do plants turn sunlight into food energy?
anchors: Photosynthesis converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose.

queries.query: chlorophyll thylakoid membranes absorb light
anchors: Chlorophyll a and chlorophyll b absorb red and blue light in the thylakoid membranes.

queries.query: Which reactions split water and release oxygen?
anchors: The light dependent reactions split water, release oxygen, and produce ATP and NADPH.

queries.query: Calvin cycle fixes carbon dioxide in the stroma
anchors: The Calvin cycle fixes carbon dioxide into sugar in the stroma using ATP and NADPH.

queries.query: How do leaves take in carbon dioxide without drying out?
anchors: Stomata control carbon dioxide intake and water loss from leaves.

queries.query: What limits how fast photosynthesis can run?
anchors: Light intensity, carbon dioxide concentration, and temperature limit the rate of photosynthesis.

queries.query: C4 plants maize photorespiration hot climates
anchors: C4 plants such as maize concentrate carbon dioxide to reduce photorespiration in hot climates.

queries.query: CAM plants stomata night malic acid
anchors: CAM plants open stomata at night and store carbon dioxide as malic acid.

queries.query: Where inside the chloroplast are thylakoids stacked?
anchors: Chloroplasts contain thylakoids stacked into grana surrounded by stroma fluid.

queries.query: Photosystem II photosystem I electron transport chain
anchors: Photosystem II and photosystem I work in series in the electron transport chain.

queries.query: Why does rubisco sometimes grab oxygen and waste energy?
anchors: Photorespiration occurs when rubisco binds oxygen instead of carbon dioxide, wasting energy.
Rubisco is the most abundant enzyme on Earth and catalyzes carbon fixation.

queries.query: Where do ATP and NADPH get made and then used up?
anchors: The light dependent reactions split water, release oxygen, and produce ATP and NADPH.
The Calvin cycle fixes carbon dioxide into sugar in the stroma using ATP and NADPH.

queries.query: What is an ordered list of numbers with direction called?
anchors: A vector is an ordered list of numbers describing magnitude and direction.

queries.query: dot product measures alignment of vectors
anchors: The dot product of two vectors equals the sum of pairwise products and measures alignment.
Orthogonal vectors have a zero dot product and meet at right angles.

queries.query: What is a rectangular array of numbers with rows and columns?
anchors: A matrix is a rectangular array of numbers with rows and columns.

queries.query: Why does the order of matrix multiplication matter?
anchors: Matrix multiplication composes linear maps and is not commutative in general.

queries.query: determinant zero singular invertible matrix
anchors: The determinant measures how a matrix scales volume; zero means singular.
A square matrix is invertible exactly when its determinant is nonzero.

queries.query: Which vectors keep their direction under a transformation?
anchors: Eigenvectors keep their direction under a matrix; eigenvalues give the stretch factor.

queries.query: When is a set of vectors redundant?
anchors: Vectors are linearly independent when no one is a combination of the others.

queries.query: rank of a matrix column space dimension
anchors: The rank of a matrix is the dimension of its column space.

queries.query: How do you project one vector onto another?
anchors: Projecting a vector onto another uses the dot product divided by the squared norm.

queries.query: cross product perpendicular 3D vectors sine angle
anchors: The cross product of two 3D vectors is perpendicular to both, scaled by the sine of the angle.

queries.query: Estates General clergy nobility Third Estate Versailles 1789
anchors: The Estates General of 1789 convened the clergy, nobility, and Third Estate at Versailles.

queries.query: What oath did the National Assembly swear about a constitution?
anchors: The National Assembly swore the Tennis Court Oath not to disband before writing a constitution.

queries.query: stormed the Bastille 14 July 1789 Paris
anchors: On 14 July 1789 revolutionaries stormed the Bastille fortress in Paris.

queries.query: Which declaration proclaimed liberty and equality?
anchors: The Declaration of the Rights of Man proclaimed liberty, equality, and popular sovereignty.

queries.query: Reign of Terror Robespierre guillotine Thermidorian
anchors: The Reign of Terror under Robespierre sent thousands to the guillotine in 1793 and 1794.
The Thermidorian Reaction arrested Robespierre and ended the Terror in July 1794.

queries.query: How did Napoleon take power and what did he replace?
anchors: Napoleon Bonaparte seized power in the coup of 18 Brumaire in 1799.
The Directory ruled France from 1795 until Napoleon's coup replaced it.

queries.query: Who marched on Versailles demanding bread in October 1789?
anchors: In October 1789 thousands of women marched on Versailles demanding bread and reforms.

queries.query: Louis XVI executed guillotine January 1793
anchors: Louis XVI was executed by guillotine in January 1793 after the monarchy fell.
